title.en: Lee Jong-suk, IU Confirm 4-Year Breakup; Fang Zhiyou, Yang Mingwei Announce Divorce
title.zh-TW: 李鍾碩（Lee Jong-suk）、IU確認交往4年分手；方志友（Fang Zhiyou）、楊銘威（Yang Mingwei）宣布離婚

summary.en: Taiwan entertainment outlets report several celebrity relationship updates. Lee Jong-suk and IU ended their four-year relationship, confirmed directly to Dispatch. Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei announced the end of their marriage after more than a decade. Additional reports cover Yu Wenle ending a nine-year marriage and other related celebrity comments.
summary.zh-TW: 台灣娛樂新聞報導多起藝人感情消息。李鍾碩（Lee Jong-suk）與IU結束4年交往，親自向Dispatch證實。方志友（Fang Zhiyou）與楊銘威（Yang Mingwei）宣布結束婚姻，歷時逾10年。另有余文樂（Yu Wenle）結束9年婚姻等相關報導。

body.en: Lede: Multiple Taiwanese media outlets cover recent celebrity relationship developments involving confirmed breakups and divorces. What happened: Lee Jong-suk and IU ended their four-year relationship, with the actor personally confirming the split to Dispatch. Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei announced their divorce after 11 or 12 years of marriage, stating they will remain family. Yu Wenle also announced the end of his nine-year marriage, with his ex-wife noting they remain lifelong family. Why it matters: These updates reflect ongoing shifts in the Taiwan and regional entertainment circles, drawing attention from fans and media. Sources agree/disagree: Outlets consistently report the Lee Jong-suk and IU breakup and the Fang Zhiyou-Yang Mingwei divorce announcement. Still uncertain: Exact duration of the Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei marriage varies slightly across reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：多家台灣媒體報導藝人感情近況，包括多起分手與離婚消息。 事件經過：李鍾碩（Lee Jong-suk）與IU結束4年交往，由男方親自向Dispatch證實分手。方志友（Fang Zhiyou）與楊銘威（Yang Mingwei）宣布結束11或12年婚姻，強調永遠是家人。余文樂（Yu Wenle）亦宣布結束9年婚姻，前妻表示仍是一輩子家人。 重要性：這些消息反映台灣及區域娛樂圈感情動態，吸引粉絲與媒體關注。 來源共識與分歧：各媒體一致報導李鍾碩與IU分手及方志友、楊銘威離婚消息。 仍未確定：方志友與楊銘威婚姻年數在報導中略有差異。

disagreements.en: Sources differ on the exact length of Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei's marriage, citing either 12 years or 11 years.
disagreements.zh-TW: 來源對方志友（Fang Zhiyou）與楊銘威（Yang Mingwei）婚姻年數有分歧，部分報導為12年，部分為11年。

title.en: Trump, Xi Wrap State Visit Centered on Spectacle Over Substance
title.zh-TW: 川普（Trump）、習近平（Xi）結束以盛況勝過實質的國事訪問

summary.en: President Trump and Chinese leader Xi concluded a two-day state visit in Washington focused on ceremony and pageantry rather than concrete deliverables. Sources highlight spectacle including pandas, with limited engagement on topics like Taiwan and Iran. The visit occurs at an important time for both leaders.
summary.zh-TW: 川普（Trump）總統與中國領導人習近平（Xi）結束在華盛頓（Washington）的兩天國事訪問，重點放在儀式與盛況而非具體成果。來源提及包括貓熊的盛況，對臺灣（Taiwan）與伊朗（Iran）等議題著墨有限。此行對雙方領導人而言時機重要。

body.en: Lede: President Trump and Chinese leader Xi wrapped a state visit in Washington centered on spectacle over substance. What happened: The two leaders engaged in heavy ceremony during two days in Washington, featuring pageantry and pandas. They went light on deliverables and danced around Taiwan and Iran. Why it matters: The visit comes at an important time for both men. Sources agree/disagree: NPR World and CNBC both emphasize the ceremonial focus and lack of substantive outcomes. Still uncertain: Details beyond the provided takeaways on pageantry, pandas, and avoided topics remain limited in the sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：川普（Trump）總統與中國領導人習近平（Xi）結束在華盛頓（Washington）的國事訪問，重點在盛況而非實質。 事件經過：雙方領導人在華盛頓（Washington）進行兩天密集儀式，包括盛況與貓熊，成果有限，並對臺灣（Taiwan）與伊朗（Iran）議題避重就輕。 重要性：此行對雙方領導人而言時機重要。 來源共識與分歧：NPR World與CNBC均強調儀式導向與缺乏具體成果。 仍未確定：來源提供的訊息僅限於盛況、貓熊與避談議題，細節有限。

title.en: Meta Opens Early Access Program for New Muse Features
title.zh-TW: Meta（Meta）開放新 Muse（Muse）功能早期存取計劃

summary.en: Meta has launched an early access program for new Muse features. Users must ask Muse directly to join the list. The Verge notes that Muse now readily provides filesystem contents on request, a change linked to comments from Meta's Nat Friedman.
summary.zh-TW: Meta（Meta）推出 Muse（Muse）新功能的早期存取計劃，使用者需直接向 Muse 請求加入清單。The Verge 指出 Muse 現在會主動提供檔案系統內容，此變化與 Meta（Meta）旗下 Nat Friedman（Nat Friedman）的評論有關。

body.en: Lede: Meta has opened an early access program for new features in its Muse AI system. What happened: According to TechCrunch, anyone interested must ask Muse to add them to the list. The Verge reports that Muse now eagerly offers filesystem contents when requested, following an earlier discovery where it exposed internal details after prompting. Why it matters: This update makes the Muse filesystem more accessible to users, providing a deeper look at the AI chatbot's operations. Sources agree/disagree: TechCrunch focuses on the early access program signup process while The Verge emphasizes the filesystem exposure change attributed to Nat Friedman. Still uncertain: Details on the full scope of new features or exact reasons for the filesystem update remain limited to the provided reports.
body.zh-TW: Lede: Meta（Meta）已開放其 Muse（Muse）AI 系統新功能的早期存取計劃。 What happened: 根據 TechCrunch 報導，有興趣的使用者必須向 Muse 請求將自己加入清單。The Verge 指出 Muse 現在會在收到請求時主動提供檔案系統內容，此前曾經在提示後揭露內部細節。 Why it matters: 此更新讓 Muse 檔案系統對使用者更易取得，提供對 AI 聊天機器人運作的更深入檢視。 Sources agree/disagree: TechCrunch 聚焦早期存取計劃的加入程序，The Verge 則強調與 Nat Friedman（Nat Friedman）相關的檔案系統揭露變化。 Still uncertain: 新功能的完整範圍或檔案系統更新的確切原因，仍僅限於所提供報導中的資訊。

blurb.en: Company developing the Muse AI system.
blurb.zh-TW: 開發 Muse AI 系統的公司。

title.en: Yao Zhengjing Reveals Reason for Breakup with Guo Fucheng, Faces Senior Artists' Cold Shoulder on Comeback
title.zh-TW: 姚正菁剖白當年與郭富城分手原因 復出遭前輩藝人白眼

summary.en: Yao Zhengjing discusses her past split from Guo Fucheng and cold reception from industry seniors upon returning to entertainment. Separate reports cover Xiao Yi disclosing breakup details with Joeman over marriage reluctance and Xiao Yi commenting on her split with Duomiduoluo.
summary.zh-TW: 姚正菁談及與郭富城當年分手原因，以及復出時遭前輩藝人冷眼。另有報導提及蕭伊在節目中揭露與Joeman分手因對方不願結婚，以及與多米多羅分手相關爆料。

body.en:
Lede: Yao Zhengjing opens up about the reasons behind her breakup with Guo Fucheng years ago while noting a chilly reception from senior artists during her entertainment comeback.
What happened: Reports detail Yao Zhengjing sharing her split explanation with Guo Fucheng. Additional coverage shows Xiao Yi appearing on a program to discuss her breakup with Joeman, stating the issue exploded whenever marriage was mentioned, and commenting that online personas should not be taken seriously in her split with Duomiduoluo.
Why it matters: These accounts highlight ongoing public interest in Taiwan celebrity relationship developments and challenges faced by artists re-entering the industry.
Sources agree/disagree: Multiple outlets report similar details on Xiao Yi's Joeman comments but focus on different individuals across stories.
Still uncertain: Exact timelines and additional context for each case remain limited to the reported statements.
Sources: ETtoday星光雲, 娛樂星聞, 三立新聞網SETN.com, 明報 Our Lifestyle, 噓！星聞, 壹蘋新聞網.
body.zh-TW:
導言：姚正菁剖白當年與郭富城分手原因，並提及復出時遭前輩藝人白眼。
事件經過：報導指出姚正菁分享與郭富城分手細節。另有蕭伊上節目談及與Joeman分手，痛訴一談結婚就爆炸，以及談多米多羅分手時表示網路人設看看就好。
重要性：這些報導反映台灣娛樂圈名人感情發展持續受關注，以及藝人復出面臨的挑戰。

title.en: Meta Connect Showcases Smart Glasses with Mark Zuckerberg Announcements
title.zh-TW: Meta Connect（Meta Connect） 展示馬克·祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg） 智慧眼鏡宣布

summary.en: Meta featured its smart glasses prominently at the Meta Connect event. CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced new models including a slimmed-down VR headset and the first camera-free glasses. Coverage also addresses controlling AI model training on visual data from the devices.
summary.zh-TW: Meta（Meta） 在 Meta Connect（Meta Connect） 活動中 prominently 展示智慧眼鏡。執行長馬克·祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg） 宣布新款，包括輕薄 VR 頭戴裝置與首款無攝影機眼鏡。報導亦提及控制 AI 模型使用眼鏡視覺資料的設定。

body.en: Lede: At Meta Connect, Meta's smart glasses took center stage as the company pushes its line of wearable tech. What happened: TechCrunch reported that the company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected via its ever-growing line of smart glasses. Engadget covered settings to stop Meta training its AI models on smart glasses' visual data, noting the setting affects whether workers can review photos and videos. Wired AI detailed Meta VR Glasses, Ray-Ban Meta Audio, Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 specs with Mark Zuckerberg announcing a handful of new smart glasses including a slimmed-down VR headset and the company’s first camera-free glasses at the Meta Connect event. Why it matters: The announcements highlight Meta's focus on integrating digital connectivity through wearables while addressing user controls over data used for AI training. Sources agree/disagree: All sources reference the Meta Connect event and Meta's smart glasses developments, with consistent mentions of new models and data privacy options. Still uncertain: Specific details on pricing, full feature lists, or exact availability timelines are not provided in the source materials.
body.zh-TW: Lede: 在 Meta Connect（Meta Connect），Meta（Meta） 的智慧眼鏡成為焦點，顯示公司推動穿戴科技。 What happened: TechCrunch 報導 Facebook 與 Instagram 背後的公司，希望透過不斷擴展的智慧眼鏡產品線，讓消費者保持數位連結。Engadget 討論停止 Meta（Meta） 以智慧眼鏡視覺資料訓練 AI 模型的設定，指出該設定影響工作人員是否能檢視眼鏡拍攝的照片與影片。Wired AI 詳述 Meta VR Glasses、Ray-Ban Meta Audio、Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 規格，馬克·祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg） 在 Meta Connect（Meta Connect） 活動宣布數款新智慧眼鏡，包括輕薄 VR 頭戴裝置與公司首款無攝影機眼鏡。 Why it matters: 這些宣布凸顯 Meta（Meta） 透過穿戴裝置整合數位連結的重點，同時處理使用者對 AI 訓練資料的控制。 Sources agree/disagree: 所有來源均提及 Meta Connect（Meta Connect） 活動與 Meta（Meta） 智慧眼鏡發展，一致提到新款型號與資料隱私選項。 Still uncertain: 來源材料未提供價格、完整功能清單或確切上市時程等細節。

title.en: Noah Woods died after getting out of play area through 'gap in the fence', inquest hears
title.zh-TW: 諾亞·伍茲（Noah Woods）在審訊中聽聞死於從遊樂區透過「圍欄缺口」走出後

summary.en: Three-year-old Noah Woods was found dead after leaving a play area through a gap in the fence, an inquest heard. His mother urged parents to hold their children tighter and cherish every moment following the incident in Suffolk.
summary.zh-TW: 三歲的諾亞·伍茲（Noah Woods）在審訊中聽聞，他是透過遊樂區圍欄的缺口離開後死亡。他的母親呼籲父母緊緊抱住孩子，珍惜每一刻，此事發生在薩福克（Suffolk）。

body.en: Lede: Three-year-old Noah Woods died after exiting a play area through a gap in the fence, according to testimony at an inquest. What happened: Noah Woods was found dead following a large search in Suffolk. The inquest heard that he had got out of the play area through a gap in the fence. Why it matters: The case highlights playground safety concerns and prompted a public message from the boy's mother. Sources agree/disagree: Sky News UK and BBC UK both report the same details on the gap in the fence and the mother's statement with no conflicts. Still uncertain: No additional details on the exact circumstances or outcomes beyond the inquest testimony are provided in the sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：根據審訊證詞，三歲的諾亞·伍茲（Noah Woods）是透過遊樂區圍欄的缺口離開後死亡。 事件經過：諾亞·伍茲（Noah Woods）在薩福克（Suffolk）進行大規模搜索後被發現死亡。審訊中聽聞，他是從遊樂區透過圍欄缺口走出。 重要性：此案凸顯遊樂場安全問題，並促使男孩母親公開呼籲。 來源一致／分歧：天空新聞英國（Sky News UK）與英國廣播公司英國（BBC UK）均報導圍欄缺口與母親聲明的相同細節，無衝突。 仍不確定：來源未提供審訊證詞以外的確切情境或結果細節。

blurb.en: Three-year-old boy whose death was the subject of an inquest.
blurb.zh-TW: 三歲男孩，其死亡事件為審訊主題。

blurb.zh-TW: 英國地點，搜尋諾亞·伍茲（Noah Woods）的行動在此進行。

title.en: Liu Peiyue Clarifies Male Artist Blacklist Rumors as Ho Peijia and Ruan Haozong Discuss Reconciliation Possibility
title.zh-TW: 劉佩玥澄清男藝人黑名單傳聞 何沛珈阮浩棕談復合可能

summary.en: East Asian celebrity gossip covers breakup announcements and possible reconciliations. Liu Peiyue addresses blacklist rumors while Ho Peijia and Ruan Haozong discuss getting back together. Other reports include splits involving Korean and Chinese stars with some companies denying rumors.
summary.zh-TW: 東亞藝人緋聞涵蓋分手宣布與可能復合。劉佩玥澄清黑名單傳聞，何沛珈與阮浩棕討論復合。其他報導包括韓國與中國明星分手，部分公司否認傳聞。

body.en:
Lede: Recent East Asian entertainment news highlights several celebrity relationship updates centered on breakups and potential reconciliations.
What happened: Liu Peiyue clarified rumors about a male artist blacklist. Ho Peijia and Ruan Haozong discussed the possibility of getting back together. Additional reports covered splits such as those involving Jung Kyung-ho and Sooyoung, Luhan and Guan Xiaotong, Kim Jung-ryul and his Taiwanese wife, and conflicting claims around Chaeyoung and Zion.T.
Why it matters: These stories reflect ongoing public interest in the personal lives of regional stars and how agencies respond to rumors.
Sources agree/disagree: Multiple outlets reported on Chaeyoung and Zion.T with some claiming a breakup and others stating the pair remains together and companies plan to take action against false reports.
Still uncertain: Details on future reconciliations and exact reasons for splits remain unconfirmed beyond the reported statements.
body.zh-TW:
導言：近期東亞娛樂新聞聚焦多起藝人感情更新，圍繞分手與可能復合。
事件經過：劉佩玥澄清男藝人黑名單傳聞。何沛珈與阮浩棕談論復合可能。其他報導包括鄭敬淏與秀英、鹿晗與關曉彤、金正烈與台籍妻子，以及彩瑛與Zion.T的衝突說法。
重要性：這些故事反映大眾對區域明星私生活的持續關注，以及經紀公司對傳聞的回應。
來源同意或分歧：多家媒體報導彩瑛與Zion.T，有些宣稱分手，有些則表示兩人仍交往，公司計劃對假消息採取行動。
仍未確定：未來復合細節與分手確切原因，除已報導聲明外仍未確認。

title.en: Leo XIV Tours Secular France, Warns of AI Machines
title.zh-TW: 利奧十四世（Leo XIV）巡訪世俗法國（France） 警告機器威脅

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV visited France and warned against losing humanity to AI machines during the first day of his trip. Sources note his efforts to appeal to both traditional and newer Catholic strongholds after Africa travels.
summary.zh-TW: 教宗利奧十四世（Leo XIV）在法國（France）之行首日警告勿因機器而失去人性。消息指出其在非洲之行後，試圖同時吸引傳統與新興天主教據點。

body.en: Lede: Leo XIV, Trying to Be Everyone’s Pope, Tours Secular France. What happened: The pontiff delivered a warning against losing humanity to AI machines on the first day of his trip to France. He raised existential concerns about scientific progress, life and human rights during a speech. Why it matters: After visiting Africa, Pope Leo’s four-day trip to France shows how he is seeking to appeal to Roman Catholicism’s original heartlands as well as to the church’s newest strongholds. title.en: Presley Gerber Dropped Off at Rehab by Friend and Sober Coach Before Death
title.zh-TW: 普雷斯利·格伯（Presley Gerber）由友人與清醒教練送往康復中心

summary.en: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, was dropped off at a Santa Monica rehab facility by a friend and his sober coach. He died at age 27. His body was cremated at Rose Family Funeral Home days later, with ashes to be kept at his parents' Malibu mansion. The cause of death is still under investigation after autopsy completion.
summary.zh-TW: 辛迪·克勞馥（Cindy Crawford）與蘭德·格伯（Rande Gerber）之子普雷斯利·格伯（Presley Gerber），由友人與清醒教練送往聖塔莫尼卡康復中心，27歲去世。遺體數日後在玫瑰家族殯儀館火化，骨灰將存放於父母馬里布豪宅。驗屍完成後死因仍在調查中。

body.en: Lede: Presley Gerber was dropped off at the Santa Monica rehab facility where he later died by a friend along with his personal sober coach. What happened: According to TMZ, Presley's team found the facility and arranged the drop-off. The death certificate confirms he was cremated at the Rose Family Funeral Home. Just Jared reports his ashes will be kept at his parents' mansion in Malibu. The autopsy was completed but the Medical Examiner awaits test results before announcing the cause of death. Why it matters: The details provide context around the circumstances of the 27-year-old's death in the entertainment world. Sources agree/disagree: TMZ and Just Jared both confirm the cremation at Rose Family Funeral Home and ongoing investigation into cause of death. Still uncertain: The official cause of death remains listed as under investigation pending test results.
body.zh-TW: 導言：普雷斯利·格伯（Presley Gerber）由友人與其清醒教練一同送往聖塔莫尼卡康復中心，之後在該處去世。 事件經過：根據TMZ報導，格伯團隊找到該設施並安排送達。正如死亡證明書所示，他於玫瑰家族殯儀館火化。Just Jared報導其骨灰將存放於父母位於馬里布的豪宅。驗屍已完成，但法醫仍等待檢驗結果以公布死因。 重要性：這些細節提供娛樂圈27歲逝世相關情境。 來源一致／分歧：TMZ與Just Jared均確認玫瑰家族殯儀館火化及死因調查持續進行。 仍未確定：官方死因仍列為調查中，待檢驗結果。

title.en: Olivia Rodrigo Unraveled Tour Setlist Revealed After Opening Night Show
title.zh-TW: 奧莉維亞·羅德里戈（Olivia Rodrigo）「Unraveled Tour」開幕夜後曲目揭曉

summary.en: Olivia Rodrigo launched her 2026 Unraveled Tour at PeoplesBank Arena in Hartford, Connecticut on September 25. The Grammy-winning singer, 23, will perform 86 shows including 10-show residencies at Intuit Dome in Los Angeles and Barclays Center in New York City, split into six acts.
summary.zh-TW: 奧莉維亞·羅德里戈（Olivia Rodrigo）於9月25日在康乃狄克州哈特福的PeoplesBank Arena展開2026年「Unraveled Tour」。這位23歲葛萊美獎歌手將演出86場，包括在洛杉磯Intuit Dome及紐約Barclays Center的10場駐唱，表演分為六幕。

body.en:
Lede: Olivia Rodrigo has kicked off her 2026 Unraveled Tour with the setlist from opening night now revealed.
What happened: The Grammy-winning singer launched the tour with a show at PeoplesBank Arena on Friday night September 25 in Hartford, Connecticut. She will perform 86 shows on her third concert tour, including 10-show residencies at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles and the Barclays Center in New York City. Olivia split the show up into six acts.
Why it matters: The tour details provide fans with the full opening night setlist and schedule for the extensive run of concerts.
Sources agree/disagree: One source covers the Unraveled Tour setlist while the other reports iHeartRadio’s 2026 Jingle Ball Tour lineup including Olivia Rodrigo along with Hilary Duff, Sombr, Raye, Adéla, Katseye, Ludacris, Dominic Fike, Myles Smith and more across a nine-city tour with varying lineups.
Still uncertain: The full setlist details beyond the six-act structure are not specified in the provided sources.
body.zh-TW:
導言：奧莉維亞·羅德里戈（Olivia Rodrigo）已展開2026年「Unraveled Tour」，開幕夜完整曲目現已揭曉。
事件經過：這位葛萊美獎歌手於9月25日星期五晚間在康乃狄克州哈特福的PeoplesBank Arena舉行開幕演出。她將在第三次巡演中演出86場，包括在洛杉磯Intuit Dome及紐約Barclays Center各10場的駐唱。奧莉維亞·羅德里戈（Olivia Rodrigo）將表演分為六幕。
重要性：巡演細節讓粉絲得知開幕夜完整曲目與龐大演出行程。
來源異同：一則來源報導「Unraveled Tour」曲目，另一則報導iHeartRadio 2026年Jingle Ball Tour陣容，包含奧莉維亞·羅德里戈（Olivia Rodrigo）、希拉蕊·杜夫（Hilary Duff）、Sombr、Raye、Adéla、Katseye、Ludacris、Dominic Fike、Myles Smith等人，在九城巡演中以不同陣容演出。
仍未確定：六幕結構以外的完整曲目細節在來源中未說明。

disagreements.en: Sources cover separate tours: Unraveled Tour setlist versus iHeartRadio 2026 Jingle Ball Tour lineup.
